title: Checks for warn/deny/forbid attributes targeting the whole clippy::restriction category.
summary: Restriction lints sometimes are in contrast with other lints or even go against idiomatic rust. These lints should only be enabled on a lint-by-lint basis and with careful consideration. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Warns when a match, if let, or while let scrutinee is wrapped in a block.
summary: This lint only triggers on the 2021 edition and older. It is unusual to write { expr } when you could just have written expr, and it is unlikely that anyone would write that for any reason other than wanting temporaries in expr to be dropped before executing the body of the match/if let/while statement. However, prior to the 2024 edition, wrapping the scrutinee in a block did not drop temporaries before the body executes. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for if and match conditions that use blocks containing an expression, statements or conditions that use closures with blocks.
summary: Style, using blocks in the condition makes it hard to read. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
